paragraphs: Hyman cites Zevachim 102a for the Rav Chisda reading in Dikdukei Soferim. He says the usual reading is R' Chiyya of Yusetanya.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: Hyman attributes the Chisda reading to Dikdukei Soferim.

The corresponding passage in the consulted Gemara is at [Zevachim 112a](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.112a.9). It reads Rav Chiyya of Yusetanya, discussing the Nasi’s goat. Hyman’s supplied locator is 102a.
The notice’s Chiyya has an abbreviated title. The consulted Gemara writes Rav in full.
